node_snap.description: The graph-theory seam. Real space is continuous - stand anywhere, walk any direction. A graph keeps only nodes and edges, a finite skeleton over the continuum. Amber: the desire line, the straight route across open ground. Blue: the route the graph permits - node to node along edges, zigzagging and longer, because the shortcut through the middle was never stored. The graph is the map admitting it kept only the crossings.
node_snap.name: Node Snap
node_snap.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for graphtheory. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
